setup: const D = window.__design; const { ops, ...g } = D.TEMPLATES.turbojetDry; window.__tjd = (mf) => ({ ...g, massFlow: mf }); window.__tjdRef = D.setSlotGraph('workshop', D.TEMPLATES.turbojetDry); a.setEngine('workshop', true); a.sim.trim(0.85, 30); if (a.advance) a.advance(10);

actions.4: a.setCutaway(false); a.applyDesign('workshop', window.__tjd(10), 'full', { reference: window.__tjdRef }); a.rig.camera.position.set(3.4, 0.4, -1.45); a.rig.controls.target.set(0, -0.05, -1.45); a.rig.controls.update();
actions.6: a.applyDesign('workshop', window.__tjd(200), 'full', { reference: window.__tjdRef }); a.rig.camera.position.set(15.5, 1.6, 0.8); a.rig.controls.target.set(0, -0.1, 0.8); a.rig.controls.update();
